name: pneu
author: Jordan McKible
description: Unread inbox mail and sync health from the pneu server, with click to open

barWidget.description: Unread inbox threads across your accounts; warns when sync fails or the server is down

schema.label: Style
schema.description: Default always shows the mark, with the unread count in the accent colour. Minimal shows the mark in the accent colour only while there is unread mail, with no count; it still appears in the urgent colour when sync is failing.

schema.label: Click command
schema.description: Run on click instead of `pneu open`, e.g. to summon a scratchpad that holds the window.
